purpose: Non-authoritative migration evidence binding every approved routing rule to the pinned predecessor source without replacing either authority.

method.atomic_clause_identity: Each approved stable rule ID is one semantic atomic clause. A compound source paragraph may support more than one clause, and a clause may cite more than one source block.
method.source_block_coverage: Every nonblank, nonheading Markdown body block in the pinned predecessor is classified exactly once as normative routing text or registered routing data.
method.structured_data_boundary: The profile table and its introductory sentence are registered routing data verified independently by route parity; they are not prose-derived rules.
method.authority_boundary: This matrix is immutable migration evidence only. It does not define routing behavior and cannot activate the Component Registry.
method.provenance_roles: The source object identifies the exact predecessor text that supplied normative clauses. The separately named design authorities identify the approved migration decisions. A source digest is not approval evidence, and a design revision is not predecessor-source provenance.

mode_semantics.deterministic_enforcement: A named production symbol rejects the modeled negative condition; the row claims no enforcement beyond that symbol and test.
mode_semantics.governing_instruction_precondition: An exact pinned governing instruction is included by the named packet route; this proves the instruction precondition only, not cognitive compliance or interception.
mode_semantics.candidate_validation_only: A candidate-only validator closes the named source or configuration condition without creating executable or active authority.
